serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Shanice: Alright, let me open you up…
…
…
Shanice: Uh-oh…
You: What, what is it?
Shanice: I found the problem.
You: Is it something bad?
Shanice: Uh-oh…
You: What is it this time?!
Shanice: Uh-oh…
You: …
#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.Serious+Nun_NewOutfit.Mouth.Smile
You: Are you really fucking with us right now? {f_botName} is about to cry.
Shanice: I’m sure she would already be crying if she could.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
Shanice: Don’t worry guys, it’s nothing major.
#bot.Expression.clear
Shanice: One of the gyroscopes failed and for some reason diagnostics couldn’t detect it. 
Shanice: I will solder a new part in and you two should be good to go.
Bot: That’s all? Really? I could fix that myself.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.Really+Nun_NewOutfit.Mouth.Normal
#bot.Expression.angry
Shanice: But you didn’t~ I’m better at fixing stuff~
#bot.Expression.clear
Shanice: Ice skating, huh. I don’t remember the last time I went ice skating.
You: What, are you interested?
#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.Really+Nun_NewOutfit.Mouth.Smile
Shanice: Are you inviting me?
#bot.Expression.happy
You: Sure, we can go all three of us.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceHappy
Shanice: Nice! I can’t wait!
#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.Really+Nun_NewOutfit.Mouth.Normal
Shanice: I’m quite a beast on skates, better be careful!
Shanice: Don’t worry {f_botName}, you will have a chance to learn from the best. An hour under my patronage and you will never fall again.
Bot: With all due respect, but I doubt that I can learn anything from a human.
Shanice: That’s because you never saw me roll!
You: Big thanks Shanice for today and see you later!
#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.Serious+Nun_NewOutfit.Mouth.Normal
Shanice: Bye!
